Build kit for "date picker"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
The idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page
